aboutPageTitle: About VocalWitness • Truth • Evidence • Public Square
aboutSubtitle: Your Voice. Your Truth. Shared with Integrity.
missionPara1: In an era of deepfakes, misinformation, and centralized control, VocalWitness restores the public square. We believe truth is not dictated by algorithms or gatekeepers — it is evidenced, witnessed, and verified by the people.
missionPara2: We empower every citizen to share raw testimonies, forensic media, and lived experiences with cryptographic integrity tools, while protecting privacy and resisting manipulation.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Photos and voice recordings receive cryptographic hashing. Advanced verification (including Zero-Knowledge proofs in development) helps establish authenticity without revealing your identity.
privacyFirstDesc: Your identity remains protected. We use phone verification, reputation systems, and privacy-preserving technology so you can speak boldly while staying safe.
communityStewardshipDesc: No single entity controls the narrative. Trust is earned through honest participation. Verified Witnesses and reputation mechanics reward integrity.
communitySupportedDesc: Fully funded by voluntary sponsorships and willing donations from people who believe in a healthier information ecosystem. No paywalls. No premium features locked behind payments.
trustStep1Desc: Start as a Citizen and earn higher trust levels through phone verification and consistent honest contributions. True Witness mode offers the strongest cryptographic guarantees.
trustStep2Desc: All media is timestamped and hashed. The Evidence Ledger preserves permanent, verifiable records of what was shared.
trustStep3Desc: We function strictly as a neutral public square and distribution medium. We do not edit, boost, or suppress content except to enforce basic safety and legal requirements.
aboutQuote: "In the age of noise, the clearest voice is the one that can prove it was never altered."
footerCopyright: © 2026 VocalWitness • Built for Truth • Evidence • Public Square
privacyIntro: At VocalWitness, we believe truth should not require sacrificing privacy. We are committed to minimizing data collection while maintaining the integrity of the public square.
privacySection1Text: We use privacy-preserving technologies (including Zero-Knowledge proofs where available) so you can participate meaningfully while protecting your identity. We do not sell user data. We do not engage in surveillance advertising.
privacyNotCollect1: Government-issued IDs, passports, or biometric data
privacyNotCollect3: Your full social graph or personal contact list
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Email or phone number (for authentication), chosen username, and basic profile data you provide.
privacyContentDesc: Testimonies, photos, voice recordings, and associated metadata (e.g., timestamps, cryptographic hashes).
privacyVerificationDesc: Phone verification status and Zero-Knowledge proofs (where implemented). We do not store the underlying private data.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous usage statistics, IP addresses (temporarily for security), and device information for spam/abuse prevention.
privacyUse1: To provide, maintain, and improve the platform
privacyUse2: To enable trust features (phone verification, ZK proofs, reputation)
privacyUse3: To enforce our Terms of Service and Safety Guidelines
privacyUse4: To respond to legal requests when required by law
privacySection5Text: You may delete your account at any time, which will remove your profile and unpublished content. However, content already published to the Public Square becomes part of the permanent record (like public speech) and cannot be fully erased.
privacySection6Text: Where implemented, ZK proofs allow us to verify that a user meets certain criteria (e.g., is human, has reached a trust threshold) without storing or revealing sensitive personal information.
privacySection7Text: We use Firebase (Google) for authentication, database, and storage. Your data is protected under their security standards. We do not share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacyImportant: Important: Public testimonies are visible to everyone. We strongly recommend that you never post highly sensitive personal information that could compromise your safety.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — a citizen-powered public square for truth, evidence, and testimony. By using our platform, you agree to these Terms of Service.
termsSection1Text: By accessing or using VocalWitness, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms. If you disagree, you must not use the platform.
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness operates as an un-manipulated distribution medium — a public square where citizens can share testimonies and evidence. We are not a publisher, we do not endorse content, and we do not act as a court of law.
termsSection3Intro: We use a layered trust model to strengthen the quality of discourse:
termsTier1: Citizen Talk — Open to all users (basic signup).
termsTier3: True Witness — Highest tier, earned through consistent participation and advanced verification (including Zero-Knowledge proofs where implemented).
termsTierNote: Higher tiers unlock greater responsibilities and capabilities (e.g., group creation, higher visibility).
termsConduct1: You are solely responsible for all content you post.
termsConduct2: You must share content you genuinely believe to be true and act in good faith.
termsConduct3: You must not post illegal, defamatory, harassing, violent, hateful, or sexually exploitative content.
termsConduct4: You must not manipulate evidence or impersonate others.
termsSection5Text: You retain full ownership of your content. By posting on VocalWitness, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual license to host, display, distribute, and archive your content on the platform and its mirrors.
termsSection6Text: Users may create or join Groups and personal networks subject to their trust tier. Group creators and moderators are responsible for enforcing community standards within their spaces. VocalWitness reserves the right to intervene in cases of serious violations.
termsSection7Text: VocalWitness is sustained entirely through voluntary community donations, transparent support funds, and direct non-custodial cryptographic contributions. Donations are non-refundable and do not grant special governance privileges or ownership over the platform.
termsSection8Text: VocalWitness and its maintainers disclaim liability for user-generated content, network disruptions, or external cryptographic verification failures.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once a record is written to the Forensic Ledger or the audit log, the application and database rules make it impossible for any user (or ordinary operator) to edit or delete it.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Firestore security rules explicitly forbid update and delete on the ledger collections.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Client-side SHA-256 hashing of media and content.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Hash-chaining of audit entries (each entry contains the cryptographic hash of the previous one).
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important clarification: This is application-level immutability. It is not a full public blockchain. The data lives in Firebase / Google Cloud. The rules and cryptography make silent changes extremely difficult, but the ultimate trust still rests on the operator’s honesty and the cloud provider’s integrity.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Planned optional strengthening (Batch 1 item 3): periodic cryptographic hashes of the ledger can be exported and pinned to IPFS and/or lightly anchored on a public chain (Polygon or Base). This is not yet active.
